repos.description: :zap: Dynamically generated stats for your github readmes
repos.summary_zh: GitHub Readme Stats 是一个动态生成 GitHub 统计信息的项目，可自动在个人 README 中展示仓库贡献、语言使用、活跃度等数据，支持高度自定义主题、布局与指标，提升开发者主页展示效果。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Readme Stats dynamically generates GitHub statistics for READMEs, displaying repository contributions, language usage, activity metrics, and more. It supports customizable themes, layouts, and options to enhance developer profile visibility.

repos.description: 🃏 A magical documentation site generator.
repos.summary_zh: Docsify 是一个神奇的文档站点生成器，可将 Markdown 文件直接转换为静态网站，无需构建流程。支持全文搜索、多主题切换、插件扩展和 Emoji 渲染，适用于快速搭建技术文档、项目说明等轻量级网站。
repos.summary_en: Docsify is a magical documentation site generator that converts Markdown files into static websites without requiring a build process. It features full-text search, multiple themes, plugin support, and emoji rendering, ideal for rapidly building lightweight technical documentation and project wikis.

repos.description: The open source frontend for GitBook doc sites
repos.summary_zh: GitBook 是一个开源的前端文档渲染引擎，专为技术知识管理而设计。它基于 Next.js 构建，支持本地开发和自定义发布站点，提供团队协作的文档管理功能，适用于开源项目和技术团队的知识共享。
repos.summary_en: GitBook is an open-source frontend engine for rendering GitBook documentation sites, built on Next.js. It enables local development and custom publishing of technical knowledge, supporting team collaboration and open-source contributions for documentation workflows.

repos.description: Documentation that simply works
repos.summary_zh: Material for MkDocs 是一个基于 MkDocs 的强大文档框架，支持 Markdown 编写，可快速生成专业、可搜索、多语言（60+）且跨设备的静态网站。提供高度定制化主题与现代化界面，适用于开源和商业项目文档。
repos.summary_en: Material for MkDocs is a powerful documentation framework built on top of MkDocs, enabling fast creation of professional, searchable, multilingual (60+), and device-agnostic static sites from Markdown. It offers a customizable Material Design theme ideal for open-source and commercial projects.

repos.description: flutter 开发者帮助 APP，包含 flutter 常用 140+ 组件的demo 演示与中文文档
repos.summary_zh: FlutterGo 是阿里巴巴推出的 Flutter 开发者辅助应用，提供 140+ 组件的中文文档与演示，帮助开发者快速掌握 Flutter 开发。因团队调整暂停维护，但计划未来迭代并招募社区贡献者。
repos.summary_en: FlutterGo is an Alibaba-developed Flutter developer helper app featuring 140+ component demos and Chinese documentation. It aids developers in mastering Flutter. Due to internal restructuring, maintenance is temporarily paused, with plans for future updates and community contributions.

repos.description: A simple, Git-powered wiki with a local frontend and support for many kinds of markup and content.
repos.summary_zh: Gollum 是一个基于 Git 的轻量级 Wiki 系统，支持多种标记语言（如 Markdown、AsciiDoc 等），提供本地前端界面和版本控制功能。它允许用户通过 Git 仓库管理 Wiki 页面，支持实时编辑、历史回溯、数学公式、图表（Mermaid/PlantUML）、BibTeX 引用等高级功能，兼容 GitHub/GitLab Wiki，适合团队协作与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Gollum is a Git-powered wiki system that enables version-controlled, human-editable text files organized in a Git repository. It supports multiple markup languages, real-time editing, page history, diagrams (Mermaid/PlantUML), math rendering, citations, and integrates seamlessly with GitHub/GitLab wikis for collaborative documentation.

repos.summary_zh: Context Hub 为编码智能体提供版本化、语言特定的 API 文档管理，支持搜索、获取和反馈功能。通过本地注释和全局反馈机制，智能体可不断积累经验并提升代码准确性，所有内容以 Markdown 格式开源维护，便于审查和贡献。
repos.summary_en: Context Hub provides versioned, language-specific API documentation for coding agents. It enables search, fetch, and feedback capabilities, with local annotations and global voting to improve agent performance over time. All content is open-sourced in Markdown format for transparency and community contribution.

repos.description: ShowDoc is a tool greatly applicable for an IT team to share documents online一个非常适合IT团队的在线API文档、技术文档工具
repos.summary_zh: ShowDoc 是一款专为 IT 团队设计的在线文档协作工具，支持 API 文档、数据字典和技术说明的编写与管理。采用 Markdown 编辑，提供模板插入、版本历史、权限控制等功能，支持响应式网页和离线导出，显著提升团队文档协作效率。
repos.summary_en: ShowDoc is an online documentation tool designed for IT teams to create and share API documents, data dictionaries, and technical specs. It features Markdown editing, template insertion, version history, permission management, responsive design, and offline export, enhancing team collaboration efficiency.

repos.description: A modern static site generator by the Material for MkDocs team
repos.summary_zh: Zensical 是由 Material for MkDocs 团队打造的新一代现代化静态站点生成器，支持 Markdown 编写，具备搜索、多语言（60+）、响应式布局等特性，专为开源和商业项目提供快速构建专业文档站点的解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Zensical is a modern static site generator crafted by the creators of Material for MkDocs, enabling rapid creation of professional, searchable, multilingual (60+ languages), and responsive documentation sites from Markdown – ideal for open-source and commercial projects.

repos.description: README file generator, powered by AI.
repos.summary_zh: ReadmeAI 是一款基于 AI 的 README 文件自动生成工具，支持通过代码仓库 URL 或本地路径一键生成结构化、详细的文档。支持 OpenAI、Ollama、Anthropic、Gemini 等多种 LLM 模型，具备智能文件过滤、离线模式运行、高度可定制化模板与样式等功能，旨在提升开发者文档编写效率。
repos.summary_en: ReadmeAI is an AI-powered tool that automatically generates high-quality README files from code repositories. It supports multiple LLM backends (OpenAI, Ollama, Anthropic, Gemini), offers customizable templates, intelligent file filtering via .readmeaiignore, and works offline. Designed to boost developer productivity and ensure consistent documentation across projects.

repos.description: Swagger Documentation Generator for Django REST Framework: deprecated
repos.summary_zh: Django REST Swagger 是一个为 Django REST Framework 提供 Swagger 文档生成的工具，现已废弃。它通过 OpenAPIRenderer 和 SwaggerUIRenderer 自动生成 API 的 OpenAPI 规范及交互式文档界面，支持自定义标题和路由配置，适用于快速构建可浏览的 REST API 文档。
repos.summary_en: Django REST Swagger was a deprecated tool for generating Swagger documentation for Django REST Framework. It provided OpenAPIRenderer and SwaggerUIRenderer to auto-generate API specs and interactive UI, enabling browsable REST API docs with customizable titles and routing, now succeeded by drf-yasg.

repos.description: Elasticsearch权威指南中文版
repos.summary_zh: 《Elasticsearch权威指南》中文版由Looly团队主导翻译，系统解析Elasticsearch核心原理与高级特性，涵盖索引设计、查询优化、集群管理等关键技术点，是深入掌握Elasticsearch的权威学习资料，支持多平台阅读。
repos.summary_en: The Chinese translation of 'Elasticsearch: The Definitive Guide', led by Looly, provides a comprehensive deep-dive into Elasticsearch's core concepts, including indexing, advanced querying, and cluster management. It serves as an authoritative resource for mastering Elasticsearch's advanced features and internal mechanisms.

repos.description: Yet another reusable writing skill for Chinese technical documentation and product copy.
repos.summary_zh: 面向中文技术文档与产品文案的写作 Skill，帮助 AI 助手（Codex、Claude Code）生成克制、准确、易读的中文技术内容。解决空泛表达、机械直译、中英混排可读性差等问题，覆盖接口文档、落地页、FAQ 等高频场景。
repos.summary_en: A reusable writing skill for Chinese technical documentation and product copy. Helps AI agents (Codex, Claude Code) generate precise, readable Chinese tech content. Solves issues like empty rhetoric, mechanical translations, and mixed Chinese-English typography. Covers API docs, landing pages, and FAQs.

repos.description: :books: 一起写Python文章，一起看Python文章 - 利用readthedocs的Python技术文章的收集和翻译。
repos.summary_zh: PyZh 是一个基于 ReadTheDocs 的 Python 技术文章翻译与收集项目，致力于汇聚优质英文技术文档并提供中文翻译。项目采用 RST 格式编写，支持多语言协作，提供 RSS 订阅和在线浏览功能，鼓励社区共同参与内容创作与翻译。
repos.summary_en: PyZh is a Python technology article translation and collection project built on ReadTheDocs, aiming to aggregate high-quality English technical articles with Chinese translations. It uses RST format, supports collaborative writing, offers RSS subscription and online reading, and encourages community contributions.

repos.description: 🖌 docsify cli tool - A magical documentation generator.
repos.summary_zh: docsify-cli 是一个强大的文档生成工具，提供快速初始化、本地服务器和实时重载功能，支持自定义主题与插件，适用于快速搭建现代化文档站点。
repos.summary_en: docsify-cli is a powerful documentation generator that offers quick initialization, local server with live reload, and support for custom themes and plugins, ideal for rapidly building modern documentation sites.

repos.description: Document Web APIs made with Django Rest Framework
repos.summary_zh: DRF Docs 是一个专为 Django Rest Framework 设计的 API 文档自动生成工具，支持 Python 2.7/3.x 和 Django 1.8+。它能自动解析 DRF 项目中的 API 结构，生成交互式文档页面，并提供配置选项控制文档可见性。项目包含演示环境，支持模板扩展，适用于需要快速搭建标准化 API 文档的中大型后端服务。
repos.summary_en: DRF Docs is an automated API documentation generator for Django Rest Framework, supporting Python 2.7/3.x and Django 1.8+. It auto-generates interactive API docs by parsing DRF project structures, with configurable visibility and template extension support. Includes a demo project for development and testing, ideal for medium-to-large backend services requiring standardized API documentation.

repos.description: Agent Skill for Chinese-first HyperFrames motion-video production from articles, products, websites, and README files.
repos.summary_zh: HyperFrames Motion Director 是一款专为中文场景优化的 AI Agent 技能，旨在将文章、产品文档或 README 快速转化为 9:16 竖版动态视频。它采用两阶段工作流（先确认创意提案，再生成素材与合成），通过严格的布局契约与动效引导，确保输出符合专业标准的宣传片与文字动画。
repos.summary_en: HyperFrames Motion Director is an AI Agent skill optimized for Chinese-first workflows, transforming articles, product docs, or READMEs into 9:16 vertical motion videos. Utilizing a two-phase pipeline (brief confirmation followed by asset generation and composition), it enforces strict layout contracts and attention-guiding animations to produce professional kinetic typography and promotional content.

repos.description: An efficient API documentation management tool that fully adheres to the OpenAPI specification and incorporates advanced LLM technology. This tool can automate the generation of API documentation, data models, and test cases, greatly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality.
repos.summary_zh: ApiCat 是一款高效 API 文档管理工具，完全遵循 OpenAPI 规范，集成先进 LLM 技术，可自动化生成 API 文档、数据模型和测试用例，显著提升开发效率与文档质量，支持本地部署与云端服务。
repos.summary_en: ApiCat is an efficient API documentation management tool fully compliant with the OpenAPI specification. It leverages advanced LLM technology to automate API documentation, data model, and test case generation, significantly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality. Supports local deployment and cloud services.

repos.description: Public docs & issues for flow.ci
repos.summary_zh: flow.ci 是一个开源的持续集成与部署平台，提供中英文双语文档和公开的问题追踪系统，旨在帮助开发者高效管理 CI/CD 流程，支持自动化构建、测试与部署。
repos.summary_en: flow.ci is an open-source continuous integration and deployment platform offering bilingual documentation (English and Chinese) and a public issue tracker to help developers streamline CI/CD workflows with automation.

repos.description: Hugo theme for engineering documentation
repos.summary_zh: OINK是一款面向工程文档的本地优先Hugo主题，通过单次构建将原生Markdown转化为完整的知识发布站点，内置搜索、图表、数学公式等组件，无需Node.js或CDN，同时支持AI代理索引、多语言及渐进增强。
repos.summary_en: OINK is a local-first Hugo theme for engineering documentation that transforms native Markdown into a complete knowledge site with one build. It bundles search, diagrams, and math locally without Node.js or CDN, and supports AI agent indexing, multilingual routing, and progressive enhancement.

repos.description: Carbon Forum HTTP API Documentation.
repos.summary_zh: Carbon Forum HTTP API 文档为开发者提供完整的论坛接口规范，涵盖用户认证、帖子管理、通知系统等核心功能，支持分页浏览、安全验证码及头像上传，适用于构建第三方论坛客户端或集成自动化工具。
repos.summary_en: Carbon Forum HTTP API Documentation provides comprehensive interface specifications for forum operations, including user authentication, topic management, notifications, and avatar handling. It supports pagination, security codes, and is designed for building third-party clients or integrating automation tools.

repos.description: Document Web APIs made with Django Rest Framework
repos.summary_zh: DRF Docs 是一个专为 Django Rest Framework 设计的 API 文档生成工具，支持 Python 2.7/3.x 和 Django 1.8+。它能自动解析 DRF 项目中的 API 结构，生成交互式文档页面，并提供安装配置指南、模板扩展及开发示例。项目提供实时 API 端点演示，支持隐藏文档和登录验证等配置选项，适合快速构建可维护的 RESTful API 文档。
repos.summary_en: DRF Docs is a tool to auto-generate interactive documentation for Django Rest Framework APIs, supporting Python 2.7/3.x and Django 1.8+. It parses API structures to create browsable docs with installation guides, template customization, and live demo endpoints. Features include optional doc hiding, login protection, and seamless integration via pip and URL routing, ideal for maintaining RESTful API documentation.
